# Xeno
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
Xenos are a species of former xenomorphs captured and raised by TSM (Trans-Solar Marines). Fearing rebellion, marines made them highly dependent on human food to survive. While retaining some xenomorph traits, they face hostility from their hive mother, who still views them as enemies.
## Surviving The Hunger
[color=#999999][italic]"Yummy!"[/italic][/color]
When a Xeno begins starving, it quickly enters choking distress. Keep asphyxiation medication on hand (such as Dexalin) or secure enough food to stay fed.
## Racial Features - You can spit acid every 7 seconds, unless you have mask on. - Starvation is [color=red]lethal[/color] for you. - Acid doesn't burn you anymore. - You are always [color=red]HUNGRY[/color]. - You slightly regenerate if you manage to calm your hunger. - Hunger doesn't slow you down.
